name: ai-prompting
description: Write, review and follow up on prompts for other AI agents and import what they send back.

interface.shortDescription: Write and review prompts for other AI agents
interface.longDescription: One skill for handing work to other AI agents: shared prompt rules, a short-pointer pattern for agents with input limits, Opal and Manus methods, starter notes for Copilot, Gemini, Antigravity, Grok, Meta AI, ChatGPT/Codex, Claude and local models, and a procedure for importing and spot-checking replies.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-prompting to write a prompt for another AI agent, or to review and import what it sent back.
